title: Squares of Evens
description:
Write `even_squares(numbers)` that returns a list of the squares of the even numbers, in order. Use a list comprehension.

Example: `even_squares([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns `[4, 16]`.
solution_code:
def even_squares(numbers):
    return [n * n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]
